user.title: Connect to Amway Atmosphere
user.description:
Welcome! Due to Amway cloud security rules, standard web browsers cannot log in directly (shows an invalid green maintenance page).

【Recommended - Fast & Secure】
1. Run on your computer: `python3 tools/get_token.py --proxy`
2. Open the mobile App and toggle your purifier switch to capture your Token.
3. Paste your Access Token below.

【Alternative】
Or enter your registered Phone Number and Password directly.
